meta.name: fix-findings
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "fix findings", "apply review fixes", "address review findings", or after a self-review produces findings. Cluster verified review findings and apply fixes interactively, with optional background execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将审查发现自动归类并逐个修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常收到审查意见,需逐条核实并修复。
copy.tagline_en: Cluster and apply verified review fixes automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get code review comments and need to verify and fix them one by one.

howto.what: Claude 会把已验证的审查发现分组，按严重程度逐个展示修复建议，让你选择应用、修改或跳过，也可用后台代理静默修复；最后汇总应用/修改/跳过/失败的数量，列出改动文件并提醒用 git diff 检查。
howto.when: 当你说出“fix findings”“apply review fixes”等指令，或自我审查产生发现时触发。若无发现或无法提示用户/写入文件，则停止不动。

say.text: 帮我修复这些 review findings
say.note: 逐个分组并征求你的同意后修改
只处理确认真实、置信度高且改动局部的问题
不做任何改动，直接停止

howto.what_en: After install, Claude clusters verified findings, steps through them offering apply/modify/skip, may run fixes in background, then reports counts and changed files, advising git diff.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'fix findings', 'apply review fixes', or after a self-review produces findings. It stops if there are no findings or if it cannot prompt/write files.

say_en.text: Help me fix these review findings
say_en.note: It clusters and applies fixes after your confirmation
Only real, high-confidence, single-site changes are applied
No changes are made and it stops
